---
title: "Miscellaneous"
description: "Reusable scientific documentation and reporting resources."
---

Miscellaneous contains reusable scientific-workflow resources that do not define
a biological or statistical method family.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### [Scientific Methods documentation prompt](miscellaneous/prompts/scientific_methods_documentation_prompt.md)

A comprehensive prompt for producing Methods-style documentation from existing
computational biology repositories while preserving scientific code and
provenance.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .resource-card}
### [Quarto scientific-report template](https://github.com/Thokas99/Useful_code/blob/main/miscellaneous/quarto/scientific_report_template.md)

A reusable Markdown reference for professional, self-contained Quarto HTML
scientific reports and their render-quality checks. The source is linked on
GitHub because it contains copy-ready executable Quarto examples.
:::

:::

These are reporting and documentation resources, not analytical templates. See
the [Miscellaneous index](miscellaneous/README.md) for their organization.
